content.text: PayPal's restrictions in Nigeria deny digital creators a platform to sell ebooks. This reality puts their livelihoods at risk. The country's exclusion from Stripe's 46-country operating list leaves Nigerians with no conventional payment options. The 180-day suspension of a PayPal account can hold funds indefinitely, cutting creators off from their earnings. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today: Ebooks nigeria

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is the minimum viable stack that can be deployed today to start selling ebooks. This stack includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment processing, and Google Drive for file delivery. With this stack, you can load up to three products and get started with automatic payment verification. This is the quickest way to set up a platform to sell ebooks in Nigeria without relying on restricted payment platforms like PayPal.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is designed to be the most straightforward way to establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can create a reliable payment processing system that's not dependent on conventional payment gateways. This stack is ideal for ebook creators who want to start selling their digital products without worrying about platform restrictions.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focusing on the core functionality of payment processing and file delivery allows you to skip unnecessary steps like setting up a full-fledged e-commerce platform. The Sovereign Starter Stack is designed to get you up and running quickly with the essential features you need to start selling ebooks. By prioritizing the minimum viable stack, you can avoid unnecessary complexity and get started faster.
With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can start selling ebooks in Nigeria without relying on PayPal's restrictive payment processing system.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
Where to sell an ebook in Nigeria?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a reliable payment processing system that's not dependent on conventional payment gateways like PayPal.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on how to sell ebooks online, check out The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. You can also visit our shop page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products and how they can help you get started with selling ebooks in Nigeria.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack and start selling ebooks in Nigeria, follow these steps: Purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack from our shop page and follow the deployment instructions. Deploy the stack on GitHub Pages and configure the payment processing system with NOWPayments. Load up to three products into the stack and configure the file delivery system with Google Drive. Test the payment processing system and file delivery system to ensure that they're working correctly. Get your first transaction live and start selling ebooks in Nigeria.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Sovereign Starter Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is a sovereign commerce infrastructure that includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment processing, and Google Drive for file delivery. This stack is designed to provide a reliable payment processing system that's not dependent on conventional payment gateways like PayPal.
Can I load more than three products into the stack?
Yes, the Sovereign Starter Stack allows you to load up to five products. However, if you need to load more products, you can upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack, which supports up to 10 products.
How long does it take to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack?

Deployment typically takes around 48 hours, during which time you can prepare your products and payment processing configuration. Once the stack is deployed, you can focus on testing the system and getting your first transaction live.
What is the cost of the Sovereign Starter Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack costs $97 and includes deployment, payment processing, and file delivery solutions. This is a one-time payment, and you won't need to pay any recurring fees to use the stack.
Can I use the Sovereign Starter Stack to sell other types of digital products?
Yes, the Sovereign Starter Stack is designed to be versatile and can be used to sell other types of digital products, such as courses, templates, and plugins.
